content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-20|Financial Sovereignty]] isolation and platform restrictions hinder digital commerce, creators face significant challenges in [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-stock-photos-without-paypal-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-every-detail-you-6|selling]] their products online. With Stripe and PayPal unavailable, and Gumroad charging a hefty 10% fee on every sale, the need for a sovereign commerce infrastructure has never been more pressing. This guide will walk you through how to start selling digital products with crypto, bypassing traditional platforms and their exorbitant fees.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-first-principles-definitive-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to give digital creators full ownership and control over their online stores, without relying on third-party platforms. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, you can create a fully functional e-commerce stack that is both secure and scalable. This approach not only eliminates platform fees but also ensures that you retain full data ownership and sovereignty over your digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce stack, you'll need to prepare a few essential components. This includes setting up a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, creating a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing, and designing your digital product offerings. You'll also need to decide on the specific cryptocurrencies you want to accept, such as Bitcoin or USDT, and configure your payment pipeline accordingly. With these components in place, you'll be ready to start building your online store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your sovereign commerce stack. You'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site, using their API to enable automatic crypto payment verification. You'll also need to configure your digital product delivery mechanism, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery process. This will ensure that your customers receive their digital products instantly upon payment confirmation, without requiring any manual intervention.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full control over your online store and digital products.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and start processing transactions. This involves configuring your NOWPayments account to accept crypto payments, setting up your digital product pricing in USD, and converting it to the desired cryptocurrency at transaction time. With your infrastructure in place, you can start selling your digital products to customers worldwide, without worrying about platform fees or restrictions. The first transaction is always a milestone, marking the beginning of your journey as a sovereign digital commerce entrepreneur.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your online store gains traction, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to handle increasing traffic and sales volume. This involves optimizing your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages site for performance, ensuring that your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend can handle the load, and monitoring your NOWPayments account for any potential issues. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the tools and templates you need to scale your sovereign commerce stack, including blueprints for advanced e-commerce configurations and strategies for maximizing your revenue potential.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a sovereign commerce infrastructure like COREMERCH, which enables you to accept crypto payments through NOWPayments. This approach eliminates platform fees, ensuring that you retain up to 99.5% of your revenue. For example, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between Gumroad (10%) and NOWPayments (0.5%) retains $921, significantly boosting your earnings.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a comprehensive solution to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This instant download package includes all 6 blueprints, 7 templates, and the guidance you need to succeed in the world of crypto-based e-commerce, helping you to create a thriving online store that operates independently of traditional platforms.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack, start by setting up your GitHub or Cloudflare account, then create a NOWPayments account and configure your crypto payment processing. Next, design your digital product offerings and set up your payment and delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Configure your digital product pricing in USD and convert it to the desired cryptocurrency at transaction time. Finally, go live, process your first transaction, and scale your infrastructure as needed to handle increasing traffic and sales volume.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee on every transaction, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee, helping you retain more of your revenue.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell digital products other than ebooks?

Yes, the COREMERCH infrastructure supports the sale of various digital products, including courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software, giving you the flexibility to diversify your offerings.
Do I need to have coding skills to deploy this infrastructure?
While some technical knowledge is helpful, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides comprehensive guidance and templates, making it accessible to creators without extensive coding experience.
How do I ensure the security of my digital products and customer data?

The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed with security in mind, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery and NOWPayments for secure crypto payment processing, protecting both your digital products and customer data.
Can I use this infrastructure to sell digital products in multiple currencies?

Yes, the NOWPayments integration allows you to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, and you can configure your pricing to convert to the desired currency at transaction time, enabling you to sell to a global customer base.
